certifiedResults.title: Oklahoma official presidential county results

certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Archived from Oklahoma State Election Board OKER API endpoints: getconfig/20241105, getelec/20241105/SW/xx, GetResults/20241105/SW/xx, and GetResults/20241105/CW/{countyCode}.

wardDetail.title: Oklahoma precinct review comparison
wardDetail.detail: Precinct-level review rows compare the official OKER presidential race to statewide race 10002, Corporation Commissioner, from the official precinct CSV export. The export covers all 77 counties and 1,986 precinct codes; nine zero-vote presidential precinct codes are excluded from review rows, and nine small counties have fewer than eight nonzero precinct rows for downstream advisory-threshold evaluation.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official OKER precinct CSV export downloaded from GetExtract/PLCSV/20241105 during advisory expansion.
